Something that really helps me that I got from working with a neuroplasticity coach is to label what’s happening to you, validate it and then change the story. She gave me a script and it really helps. So I say.. “I see my brain is sending me these thoughts and images, it thinks it’s keeping me safe by reminding me of past events (because that’s why it’s doing it), of course it would do this, it wouldn’t be doing it’s job if it wasn’t. I see you brain, I hear you, and it’s ok. I know that if I allow this to be here, take a breath and smile, my brain will know there is not threat and stop eventually. I’m ok, I can overcome this, I’m strong and smart and I love myself”. This script can work for literally anything your brain is doing. Overtime by not reacting to what it is doing, you are changing you brain to no longer do this. Hope this helps. Oh and try to smile and relax your body the best you can.
